generator: scratchpad sampler (PowerShell, PrintWindow + pixel histograms), read only

dpi.note: Sampled at 200 percent scale, the scale the machine runs at. Pixel values do not depend on scale; box sizes do.

regedit.launch: Start-Process with __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker set on the child only; no UAC prompt

method: Held Local\BwcGuiTestLock for the whole run.
Keyboard only, plus SetCursorPos for hover. No clicks, no edits, no registry writes.
Navigated the tree from Computer with Home, Down, Down, Right, Down, Down to HKEY_CURRENT_USER\AppEvents\Console (the Console key shows values in the list).
Captured the main window with PrintWindow (PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) into a 32 bpp bitmap and read pixels as 0xAARRGGBB.
Found each selection box by the exact fill color inside the pane rectangle, then read the pixel one device pixel outside the box (outer) and one inside (inner).
Hover was tested by moving the cursor over an unselected tree row and counting changed pixels against the focused baseline.

selectedFocused.state: Tree has keyboard focus, Console selected
selectedFocused.borderPlacement: outside the fill, all four sides
selectedFocused.boxScreen: 358,715 to 479,747 fill (exclusive right/bottom), border one pixel further out

selectedNotFocused.state: Tree lost focus (list focused or address bar focused), Console still selected

hover.result: No visible highlight. Changed pixels in the row under the cursor vs the focused baseline: 0.
hover.reason: The tree does not use TVS_TRACKSELECT, so Explorer TREIS_HOT is never requested.

selectedFocused.state: List has keyboard focus, first value (Default) selected
selectedFocused.note: Classic list view, not the Explorer visual style. The tree and list differ, so the Explorer ListView theme does not describe classic regedit.

selectedNotFocused.state: List lost focus, value still selected
selectedNotFocused.result: No selection drawn. The row background is #FFFFFF (COLOR_WINDOW). The list does not keep the selection visible when unfocused (LVS_SHOWSELALWAYS not set).

hover.state: Cursor over an unselected value row
hover.result: No hot fill observed. Only window, text and icon colors appear in the row. Pixel diff was not computed for the list.

unverified: Tree text color under hover and unfocused states was read as the darkest pixel, #000000, not from a separate text-color query.
The list hover conclusion is from the color histogram only.
